runner_behavior.state_reset: zero all 48 explicit state inputs and rebuild the attention mask
runner_behavior.linear_state_update: copy each complete recurrent and causal-convolution output into its next input
runner_behavior.full_attention_state_update: insert each one-token K/V output at the current position of its 4095-slot explicit cache
runner_behavior.profiling: QNN runtime log/profile controls, ETDump, and request/model-step timing fields
